aboutP1: Iyi si yerekana amashengero Gatolika, amashapeli, ingoro nyeranda, bazilika na katedrale {n}. Biva mu {a1}makuru y'ahantu ya Overture Maps{end} (verisiyo {release}), akoranya ahantu avuye kuri Meta, Microsoft n'izindi nkomoko zuguruye.
aboutP2: Muri ayo, ahantu {cat} handitswe muri Overture nk'ahasengerwa h'Abaroma Gatolika. Ahandi {name} handitswe gusa nk'ahasengerwa h'Abakirisu, kandi hashizwemwo kubera ko amazina yaho yerekana neza ko ari Gatolika (nk'akarorero “Parroquia”, “Paróquia”, “Basilica”, “Nossa Senhora”). Insiguro zaho zifise icitonderwa.
aboutP3: Nta makuru yuguruye arimwo amaparuwase yose. Amakuru ni menshi muri Amerika no mu Buraya bw'Uburengero, ni make mu bice bimwe vya Afrika na Aziya, aho amaparuwase menshi ataragera ku ikarata. Bimwe bishobora kuba vyanditswe kabiri, ari ibiro, canke inyubakwa zugawe. Iyo ufunguye ishengero, urupapuro rurondera ifoto yaryo kuri {a1}Wikimedia Commons{end} na Wikipedia hakurikijwe aho riri n'izina ryaryo, rukavuga n'uwayifashe. Amashengero adafise ifoto yerekana igishushanyo. Ikarata yose ifise amahuza y'ayandi mafoto, amasanamu na Street View.
